match.description: Ija Ominira is the cinematic transposition of a novel by Faleti. It is the story of a tyrannical and cruel king who is killed by his people, now tired and exasperated.

The story follows a man named Austin who seeks to upgrade his social status by pursuing and romancing a woman from a wealthy political family, abandoning true love in pursuit of greed and wealth, only for his ambition to end in heartbreak.

An avid baker who aspires to open up her own bakery is offered the opportunity to make enough money to do so by playing girlfriend to her friend’s boss whose parents are coming into town for the weekend, however his arrogance threatens to ruin the whole deal.

Two friends Cleo (Funke Akindele) and Alice (Queen Nwokoye) live a fake life in the city, they think they are on top of their game till Cleo comes across Shania (Nse Ikpe Etim) who beats them to their game, Cleo becomes anxious to know more about Shania, she traces her and finds out who she really is.

Before a father forbids his child to call him father, then the child might have committed a grievous offense. Senator Ezekiel has two daughters, Nancy and Whitney, the elders being Nancy is rather the black sheep of the humble and wealthy family. Her name is forbidden to be mentioned in the house or anywhere around the Senator. Her younger sister Whitney is not supposed to be anywhere near or have anything to do with her. Watch and find out why a father could actually be heartless towards his daughter. [parts 1-2]

Hitler and his friends set the campus on fire with their robbery, drug dealing and wild antics. George, the son of a general, falls in love with the Wife of Hitler and there is a wild chase in to the Caniball Kingdom.

For their diminutive size, the quest to find love and their history of mischief and pranks strike as distasteful attributes that hampers their efforts and remains a stumbling block. Still convinced and hopeful of success, the inhibiting and unrelenting pursuance to eventually succeed led to crafty and cunning choices. But would they ever succeed or rather resort to extreme methods when all other attempts fail? [parts 1-2]

Ejike Asiegbu plays the role of Anti Christ whom has come according to the scripture to take over the ruler-ship of the earth with the sole mission of dragging so many people as many as possible to Satan before the coming of the one main saviour.

Angelica and Andrew dated for three years before Andrew travelled abroad to Austria. While away, news reaches him of Angelica’s promiscuous lifestyle in the village, prompting him to marry an Austrian woman, Anna, instead. Guided and influenced by her calculating mother, Angelica views relationships as transactional commodities and, through deceptive schemes, sets out to wreck Andrew's new marriage and claim him back for financial gain.

The Ikenga, which belongs to the King of Amanze, is missing therefore the people of Amanze plan to attack the people of Akabo over the missing Ikenga. The king places his daughter as the price for anyone who first finds his Ikenga. The gods have chosen Mgbada and Eneh for the mission, but there seems to be a lot of mischief going on.

There lives a very big Python in the village Ngwuzu, this python keeps killing children, the old and animals in the community…. It has lived and terrorized their community for a very long time… the Elders are fed-up and decided to consult the chief priest about what to do with the python.

The Story of a roadside food vendor who comes across a stranded wealthy man and offered him shelter while he awaits his car mechanic. An attempt to help her out from her life of poverty wrecked his home. Saint Obi, Monalisa Chinda, Oby Edozie.

Mezu discovers he's trapped in a time loop in Nigeria. To his surprise, his colleague Kamsi is in the same predicament. Together with their friends Tobe, Wasiu, and Sola, they must unite to break free.

In 'Win or Lose', a struggling family man living with his family in the ghetto suddenly comes into possession of a winning lottery ticket - and a series of hilarious events unfold as he tries to enjoy his new found status.

Set in a high society secondary school, the story explores the reality of high school finalists while focussing on young and ever cheerful Jidenna Khalil Mbunabo played by Clinton Joshua, who always tried to make everyone happy anyway he can.Treasure in the sky is more of a tragic love story and though it portrayed happy stories in the beginning, the ending was quite emotional thanks to the chain of  tragic events and encounters that followed after.

A raucous village girl is overjoyed when a sophisticated city man who has just returned from America takes interest in her, however he is warned by elders in the village that she is a troublemaker and so she decides to prove to him that she is worth marrying.
Omo Ghetto (Child of the Ghetto) franchise tells the story of twin sisters leading separate lives but are reunited by series of dramatic twists.

A razz village girl who has never left her community is plunged into a sophisticated new world when she goes to university in Lagos. She quickly learns that she must fight to earn respect and become popular.

Ofoma suffers relentless and brutal abuse from his stepfather, Ehis. Ofoma’s mother, Endurance, endures her son’s suffering in silence, unable to confront her husband. Despite the abuse, Ofoma has an unwavering love for baseball. This passion leads to trouble when Ehis wrongly accuses him of stealing money to watch baseball games.
A young man attends a college reunion with a fake girlfriend in an attempt to make his ex jealous.

After her estranged father’s death, Oluchi , an upcoming musician is forced to confront her true self and past mistakes. She reconnects with her daughter through their love for music. However, the echoes from the past spring from every corner, threatening to bring them down.

Mr Coker, a wealthy, talented, and charming artist, falls head over heels in love with Jacqueline, a woman profoundly devoted to her Christian faith and to her fiancé, Victor. Because of her strong beliefs and prior commitment, Coker's repeated declarations of love are completely ignored. However, fate intervenes, bringing them together in a high-stakes business arrangement proposed by the irresistible artist himself, forcing Jacqueline to face a truly critical decision between her faith, her promises, and her heart.

Prince Arinze and Kasie grew up together, sharing a deep passion. However, owing to an inevitable circumstance, they got separated for years. Just at the moment the prince is expected to take a wife, something happened, and that marks the beginning of an unexpected adventure of the heart.

After the humiliation and pain Chinenye and her family went through in the hands of a woman whom they all worked for as maids in her house, favor finally smiled on them as their little sister, Chioma brings joy to the family again

In the sequel to the movie Stolen Kiss, tension mounts as the good for nothing older brother of the Umejesi family, Dan (Van Vicker) fights tooth and nail against his younger brother Victor (Jim Iyke) over the will. Now Victor must take the most unbelievable action to uphold peace in the family hence taking us to a different and more interesting and suspenseful angle of the whole story.

When her fellow peers in the village constantly rebuff a beautiful girl, Olamma demands an explanation from her parents and is told of the damning effect history has on her descendants, resulting in their entire lineage to be considered Osu (outcasts) in AFAN-ASA village. She therefore vows not to engage with any man till her death. [parts 1-2]

Jerry,[Desmond Elliot] a player and also into internet scam having his best friend Chizy (Fred Aseroma)his lawyer to cover up his tracks started having problem with his friend all because of a girl called Oyinda? Who is Oyinda? And what is she to one of them? Find out in this Compelling movie Yahoo Millionaire 1&2.Starring Desmond Elliot, Rita Dominic, Uche Jombo, Fred Aseroma. Produced by Emem Isong/Hyacinth Onwuka and Directed by Lancelot Oduwa Imasuen.

Guli yearns for her mother's approval and dreams of attending university, but financial struggles hold her back—until she discovers a shocking family secret. Fueled by hurt and anger, she decides to carve her own path. As Guli navigates this new chapter, she must decide how her past will shape her present.

A noble daughter of the gods, who occupies a sensitive role in her village goes out of her way to find a solution to the problems her community is facing. In order for this problems to be solved she needs to make a sacrifice she isn't prepared for.
A mother's greatest mistake becomes her chance at redemption when love demands the ultimate sacrifice.

A humble cleaner enters Heartbreak Season 1, a TV reality show where the most heartbroken wins the grand prize. He narrates his pathetic story of how finding love on a deserted island caused him to end up reinventing his life in the most spectacular fashion.Starring Yul Edochie, Cha Cha Eke Faani, Eve Esin, Marcathy Nonwani and Duke Emmanuel
A wealthy orphan is well on her way to destruction, which has been orchestrated by her best friend, but she finds an unlikely guardian angel.

While rape is regarded as the most unreported crime globally, it has assumed an epidemic proportion due largely to impunity, Idara is a gruesome tale of the adverse effects of rape on an individual when the perpetrators of the crime are left unpunished.

An intriguing story of three women crossed by fate, one a drunkard, another a Ghost and the other, a murderer. A struggle ensue as the drunkard seek for justice the dead. An investigation is launched, more information become know about the murderers, they fight back.

On their daily commute, a widower Dozie and his little girl Kamsi, fall victim of a violent gun battle. A stray bullet hits Kamsi and puts her life in jeopardy. In the face of overwhelming odds, Dozie finds out how crazy a father can be when the life of his only child is in danger.
A young woman gets more than she bargains for and is drawn into a web of deceit when she is hired by a socialite to assist with his scheme to marry a wealthy heiress.

A greedy son aims to claim his father's wealth as his rightful inheritance through devious means. Leveraging on the mental state of the heir apparent, he leaves no stone unturned while carrying out this mission.
When the patriarch of an emigrant Nigerian family visits their female-led Canadian home, traditional values collide with newer ones.
A pair of male and female friends seem to get along until the man starts falling in love but the lady doesn't feel the same. Things turn sour when a third party is involved.
No Plot Available
A pastor's life is uprooted when a member of his congregation accuses him of assualt when he refused her advances

Princess was born into witchcraft, initiated at a very tender age. When she falls in love with Desmond, she ignores the instruction of the witch council to remain celibate all her life. She goes on with her wedding and they decide to punish her.
A newlywed couple takes a luxurious vacation with their unmarried friends -- but a wild night on the town leads to revelations, doubts and dilemmas.

Adebisi, a young woman from a wealthy family, has her life shattered by her father's controlling grip. Finally allowed to experience freedom through the NYSC program, she embarks on a journey of self-discovery, befriending a young man from a humble background who challenges her perspectives. As she begins to find her voice and assert her independence, her father's wrath looms large. In a desperate bid to protect her daughter, Adebisi's seemingly docile mother reveals a depth of strength and determination, confronting the secrets and lies that have defined their family's dynamics. As the mother's hidden narrative unfolds, the film exposes the complexities of mother-daughter relationships, unresolved grief, and the struggle for individuality.

The story of billionaire industrialist Chief Beecroft, a flamboyant benefactor to a large extended family of relatives, household staff and assorted mistresses. Chief lives large, like there’s no tomorrow, until the day he dies suddenly and the ‘bullion van’ stops. What’s in his will and who gets all that money? What happens next will surprise you, as Chief Daddy has the last laugh from beyond the grave.
A man sells his soul to obtain wealth but when he passes away, he becomes trapped between life and death.
Corruption threads to destroy a young love.

King of thieves is an epic tale of Agesinkole, an all-powerful Bandit and his reign of terror in the prosperous Kingdom of Ajeromi. Concerned by his pillaging, the kingdom moves to destroy him, through the hunters, witches and priests, thus beginning this adventurous saga of revenge, bravery and glory.

Kenneth Abah, the managing director of hills group and the son of a famous and influential family is married to Susan, a graduate in law and the daughter of a dry cleaner.  Thanks to Ken's social status and arrogance his loving wife becomes his maid. But when Susan becomes tired and complains, he proposes a divorce. Will she accept his proposal or continue with this domestic slavery?

A Young woman's Deception became her Destiny; Scarlet Adams is a working class young lady who barely has time for her love life. However when her mother called to announce her Impending Visit to Nigeria, Scarlet knew she needed a Fiancée as Soon as Possible.

Melodrama about marriage.

When a usurper, Lapita, seizes the throne of Jogbo the scene is set for a film about the power struggles and corruption of a mythical African state tied up to the rituals of kingship – principally the beating of the Saworoide (or brass bell) drum. A homespun political parable emerges drawing interest by converting the typically unstable African political stereotypes into a fable complete with songs and a Greek Chorus that reflect upon the plot.
A poor Nigerian woman named Maami protects her young son, Kashimawo, from his father who carries a terrible secret.

summaya a young poor girl falls in love with mahmoud a guy who live an average man,as their relationship develop they both start their love journey not long summaya started school presdo a son of a wealthy man saw her and falls in love with her.
Kamal and Bashir finish their first degree and become pride and ambitious, they become to pride for a side jobs their only mission is to start somehow big and become rich in no time with that degree.

Isila, a young woman from the ghetto, that encounters a ghost called Mike in need of her assistance to communicate with the people he left behind. She becomes tangled and puzzled in solving a murder mystery.

Prince Yul's promiscuous ways in the palace got out of hand when he started having an affair with his own cousin. His fiancee caught them in the act which led to their separation. As royalty, his family covered his shame and brought his fiancee back. But the trust she had for him is broken, leading to insecurity in their relationship. Is there any truth in her constant accusation of him being promiscuous or is she just scared of his past behavior resurfacing?

After years of fighting to survive on the streets of Lagos, two brothers fall on opposite sides of the law. The bonds of brotherhood are put to the ultimate test as one joins a Taskforce that hunts down the other and his gang.

When the heir apparent of Ilupeju village learns through prophecy that he will not ascend the throne, he and his fiancée defy fate, employing dark rituals to secure power—only to face devastating consequences.
A woman trying to escape her past forms an unexpected bond with a young girl nearly lynched for stealing, forcing her to confront her own history and redefine her future.

The story follows Mimisola, a woman married to a wealthy millionaire named Felix. Behind his charming and successful public facade, Felix harbors a terrifying dark side and shocking secrets as a serial abuser. Mimisola is left torn between running for her life and fighting to expose the truth.

After a miscarriage, a loving couple must live under the same roof with both their mothers who can't stand each other.  A series of events force them to settle their differences and make peace with each other.

A traumatized kidnapping survivor begins to heal when a compassionate doctor uses music to reach her, but their growing bond blurs the line between professional care and forbidden love.
A 19-year old woman from a remote village is drawn by the promise of helping her sick mother but ends up as the house help for a wealthy family.
